“329，帮我拿下浴巾！”

霖多多洗完澡才发现忘拿浴巾，好在她上周抽奖中了台仿生家政AI机器人，这点小活交给它就行了。

门外，西装革履的男人听到这种指令躯体一僵。他才不是什么仿生AI，他的真实身份，是A市首富家的大少爷——上官程。

他从小体弱，生母早逝。继母表面宠溺，实则阴毒，尤其在生下弟弟后，更是巴不得他死了。

25岁那年，父亲意外去世。上官程在继母的“照料”下身体每况愈下，三年后死在了手术台上。下葬时，胸口那道手术伤口都没缝合，惨得连殡仪馆的工作人员都看不下去。

他死后怨魂不散，被快穿局捞去做任务，咬着牙肝完整整一千个任务，才换来一次重生的机会——回到三年前的25岁，且拥有了一副健康的身体。

他本以为可以逆天改命：复仇、虐渣、夺回一切！

结果技术失误，他的魂魄竟被投进了这具跟他原身长得一模一样的机器人体内，还被个刚上大三的丑丫头当成男仆使唤！

霖多多等了一会儿不见动静，催促道：“浴巾在院子里晾着，快点，好凉！”她每到周末就会从学校宿舍搬出，回到城郊这处农村小院。姥姥、姥爷留给她的，里面承载着祖孙三人数不清的美好回忆。

随着霖多多的催促，细微的电流穿过上官程的脊背，带来些许刺痛。上官程轻“嘶”一声，这是对他惰待主人指令的电击惩罚，若再不执行命令，电量便会加大，受的痛便不是这么轻描淡写了。

迫于无奈，上官程应了声“遵命”，将浴巾取了过来。行至浴室门口，礼貌的敲响了磨砂玻璃门。

“咔”——浴室门轻快的打开，纤细嫩白的手臂从门缝伸出，粘着晶莹的水珠。

霖多多一把捞走了上官程手中的浴巾，而后竟是门也不关，便擦拭起来。

上官程猛的别过脸，但机器人的视野广阔，余光中，他依旧清晰可见那道晃动的身影。肤白如玉，线条起伏。

机器人没有呼吸，没有心跳，但电路中突然加速的电流昭示了他的慌乱。

自小遭受继母的虐待，令他对女人产生了强烈的排斥感。

他生前从未与任何女性有过亲密接触，死后做的一千个快穿任务也皆与女人无关，就连家中养的动物、植物也尽是雄性。

可造化弄人，十分厌女的他如今竟然与一个女生朝夕相处，还要听从对方各种羞耻的命令。

忍无可忍，上官程关闭了视觉功能。

"329, help me get the towel!"

After Lin Duoduo took a bath, she realized that she had forgotten to take her bath towel. Fortunately, she won a bionic housekeeping AI robot in a lottery last week, so she could just leave this small job to it.

Outside the door, the man in a suit froze when he heard this instruction.He is not a bionic AI. His true identity is Shangguan Cheng, the eldest son of the richest family in City A.

He was frail since childhood and his biological mother died young.The stepmother looks doting on the surface, but is actually vicious. Especially after giving birth to her younger brother, she wished he was dead.

When he was 25 years old, his father died unexpectedly.Shangguan Cheng's health deteriorated under the "care" of his stepmother, and he died on the operating table three years later.When he was buried, the surgical wound on his chest was not sutured, and it was so miserable that even the funeral home staff could not stand it.

After his death, his resentment lingered, and he was recruited by the Quick Travel Bureau to do tasks. He gritted his teeth and completed a thousand tasks before getting a chance to be reborn - to return to the 25-year-old three years ago and have a healthy body.

He thought he could change his destiny against the will of heaven: take revenge, torture the scum, and take back everything!

As a result, there was a technical error, and his soul was actually thrown into the body of a robot that looked exactly like his original body. He was also used as a manservant by an ugly girl who had just entered junior high school!

Lin Duoduo waited for a while but saw no movement, and urged: "The bath towels are hanging out in the yard, hurry up, it's so cold!" She would move out of the school dormitory every weekend and return to this rural courtyard on the outskirts of the city.What her grandma and grandpa left to her contains countless beautiful memories of her grandparents and grandchildren.

Following Lin Duoduo's urging, a tiny electric current passed through Shangguan Cheng's back, causing a slight sting.Shangguan Chengqing "hissed", which was an electric shock punishment for his laziness in waiting for the master's instructions. If he did not follow the instructions, the electricity would increase, and the pain he suffered would not be so light.

With no choice, Shangguan Cheng said "yes" and took the towel over.He walked to the bathroom door and knocked politely on the frosted glass door.

"Click" - the bathroom door opened briskly, and slender white arms stretched out from the crack of the door, dripping with crystal water.

Lin Duoduo took the bath towel from Shangguan Cheng's hand, and then started wiping it without closing the door.

Shangguan Cheng turned away fiercely, but the robot's field of vision was broad, and he could still clearly see the shaking figure in his peripheral vision.Her skin is as white as jade, with undulating lines.

The robot was not breathing or heartbeating, but the sudden acceleration of the current in the circuit revealed his panic.

Being abused by his stepmother since he was a child, he developed a strong sense of rejection towards women.

He had never had close contact with any woman during his lifetime, and the thousand quick-travel missions he performed after his death had nothing to do with women. Even the animals and plants raised at home were all male.

But luckily for him, who is very misogynistic, he is now spending time with a girl day and night, and has to obey all kinds of shameful orders from her.

Unable to bear it, Shangguan Cheng turned off the visual function.
